# Self-test evidence (SYNTHETIC data — not the real reconstruction)

These files come from `python -m badapple_dr selftest`, run in the development environment on
**synthetic** videos generated by `badapple_dr/selftest.py`. They demonstrate that the software works
end-to-end; they are **not** Bad Apple!! or DELTARUNE footage and are never used as source imagery.

* `selftest_report.json`: all 18 automated checks (all passed), timings, baseline accuracies.
* `synthetic_quality_report.json`: the `quality_report.json` the pipeline wrote for the synthetic run.
* `synthetic_frame_mapping_head.csv`: the first rows of the generated `frame_mapping.csv`.
* `synthetic_contact_sheet.png`: reference frames (left of each pair) and the selected library frames
  (right), as analysis images.
* `synthetic_comparison_frame.png`: one frame of the diagnostic `comparison_10s.mp4`.

Key results of the synthetic run:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Planted (ground-truth) segment selected | 216/216 non-black frames (100 %) |
| Decoys selected (same mean brightness / mirrored / inverted) | 0 |
| Brightness-only baseline on the same database | 11.6 % correct |
| Tone-layout-only (12×16 L2) baseline | 95.8 % correct |
| Output | 240 frames, 24/1 fps, 10.000 s, audio 10.000 s |
| Audio sync | cross-correlation offset 0.0 ms; beep onsets within 2 ms of design |
| Output frame == selected source frame | 240/240 (max mean abs. difference 0.37/255, compression only) |
| Timestamp re-decode (traceability) | identical (difference 0) |
| Interrupted + resumed database == uninterrupted | identical (1,777 rows, 6,727 frames) |
| Export from a second (720p) rendition | all frames matched (max difference 3.1/255) |
